Bones of the Disir Queen®

Game Legend / Quick Reference

Opening

1. The Wager — Agree upon the trinkets to be wagered.

2. Honor the Queen — If a glass is present, toast the Queen. If no drink is available, both players state: “For the Queen.”

3. The Queen’s Coin — Choose heads or tails and toss the Queen’s Coin. The winner chooses who will go first.

Round Order

Cast the Runes → The Queen’s Influence → Call Upon a Fate Bone → Fate Is Set → Score the Round

Five rounds total.

Loki’s Helm

Runes showing Loki’s Helm are dead for the round. They cannot be rerolled by either player, by an Ant, or by the Serpent. Only the Wolf Fate Bone can challenge Loki’s Helm and reroll those Runes.

The Queen’s Influence

1 Ant rerolls 1 eligible non-Loki Rune. 2 Ants reroll 2 eligible non-Loki Runes. Each Ant is single-use for the game. Ant armies cannot affect Loki’s Helm and must be used before Fate Bones are called upon.

Fate Bones

Wolf: reroll all seven Runes, including Loki’s Helm.
Raven: opponent −5 for the round, minimum 0.
Serpent: reroll exactly 3 eligible Runes; no Loki’s Helm.
Bear: protect up to 3 active Runes.
Stag: +10 to the player’s round score.

Scoring

Pair 2 · Two Pair 4 · Three of a Kind 6 · Full House 10 · Straight 10 · Four of a Kind 12 · Five of a Kind 18 · Six of a Kind 36 · Seven of a Kind with no Loki’s Helm 36 + automatic round win · Seven Loki’s Helms = automatic round loss.

Bone Judgment

Wolf → Raven → Serpent → Bear → Stag

The winner doubles their Round 1 score and adds that doubled amount to their accumulated score. If tied, neither player receives the bonus; scores are totaled as they stand.

NO CHAMPION HOLDS FORTUNE FOREVER.
